title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-taylor-chen-2026-03-16
content:
TODAY (2026-03-16) - quick triage notes and TODOs

Context:
- Customer report (CS-4521) -> complaining that per-route latency heatmap on /console/routes page shows 0 tokens for a subset of requests starting ~2026-03-13. Affects a handful of enterprise tenants.
- Related internal ticket JIRA-INF-2034 created by SRE on 2026-03-14 after noticing missing traces for the same time window.
- Observed in staging + prod (prod region us-west-2) but appears intermittent.

Immediate checks done (timestamps are local):
- 09:15: Verified dashboard time range and filters (last 7d) -> heatmap still showing blanks for tenant ids T-442, T-449.
- 09:23: Queried raw metrics (prometheus) for token_count_per_request{route,tenant} -> metric present for most tenants but zero-valued series for T-442/T-449 between 2026-03-13 00:00 and 2026-03-14 12:00.
- 09:35: Pulled logs from route-processor service (pods route-processor-*) -> no obvious errors, a few WARNs about ``kv-cache-miss`` spikes around 2026-03-13 02:xx.
- 09:50: Checked trace sampling config -> unchanged; sampling rate 1% for batch jobs, 10% for live traffic.

Hypothesis (short):
- A batching/regression in route-processor caused token_count metric to be emitted as 0 for certain tenants for ~36 hours. Could be a race in metrics aggregation or a label permutation bug (tenant label nullified when cache-miss + fallback path executed).

Repro steps to run (next):
- [ ] Run local replay of production trace for T-442 between 2026-03-13 01:00 - 03:00 using playback tooling (playback/route-replay). Note: need prod replay token from SRE vault.
- [ ] Instrument route-processor locally with extra debug logs around metric emission (add log lines inside emitTokenCount()). Use PR #3287 as base patch.
- [ ] Re-run prom queries after replay to see if zero-series reproduced.

Short-term mitigations:
- If we confirm metrics were miss-labeled, add a one-off fix to backfill/normalize series in Prometheus/Graphana (use promtool to rewrite series) and update dashboards to tolerate missing tenant label. Owner: Maya. ETA: 48h.
- Add alert (temp) for sudden drop to 0 in token_count_per_request across >1% of tenants. Owner: Jordan. ETA: 24h.

Notes from Slack thread (C01OBSERR):
- @maria-cs: "customers saw blank heatmap starting Sat midday, support sent workaround to refresh dashboards but that's cosmetic"
- @samir-rao: "I think there's a race where the fallback path clears tenant label on metric emission when kv-cache-miss==true"
- Link: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C01OBSERR/p1678770000000

Follow-ups + owners (w/ rough due dates):
- Maya Li: run replay + reproduce locally (due 2026-03-18)
- Jordan Kim: create temp alert and dashboard guardrail (due 2026-03-17)
- Priya Patel: coordinate customer comms + CS-4521 status updates (email + CS ticket) (due 2026-03-16 EOD)
- Taylor Chen (me): open PR for additional debug logging + doc change for metrics invariants (drafted, need review) (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3287). Target merge: 2026-03-19.

Other related anomalies spotted while digging:
- Latency distribution panel on /console/routes sometimes flips from p50->p99 being equal for short windows. Suspect a data-aggregation hiccup in the timeseries rollup job (rollup-worker v2.1.4 deployed 2026-03-12).
- Noted that rollup-worker deploy coincides with start of customer reports. Ticketed as JIRA-INF-2036 (owner: SRE).

Quick checklist for next 72h:
- [ ] Replay prod traffic for T-442/T-449 (Maya)
- [ ] Confirm whether zero-token series are present in raw ingestion vs aggregation (Taylor)
- [ ] Add guardrail alert (Jordan)
- [ ] Draft customer-facing note (Priya + CS)
- [ ] Backfill/normalize affected series if root-cause is aggregation label loss (Maya + SRE)

Loose thoughts / notes to self:
- Might need to add unit test for metric emission when kv-cache-miss==true (edge case).
- If rollup-worker is culprit, prioritization: hotfix to revert v2.1.4 -> v2.1.3 for rollup timeframe? Need SRE sign-off.
- Keep docs updated at Confluence: OBS-DASH-ROOT -> add "investigation template" section for tenant-metric issues.

Meeting notes (standup 2026-03-16 10:30):
- Quick sync 10:30 with Maya, Jordan, Priya. Agreed: replay first, temp alert second, customer comms ASAP.
- Action: Jordan to paste alert query in Slack channel once created.

Misc commands used / worth rerunning:
- promql: sum by (tenant,route) (rate(token_count_total[5m]))
- kubectl: kubectl logs -n observability -l app=route-processor --since=72h | grep "emitTokenCount" -n
- replay: ./tools/route-replay --tenant T-442 --start "2026-03-13T01:00:00" --end "2026-03-13T03:00:00" --dry-run

-- end of scratchpad --

(keeping this doc informal; will move findings to Confluence once we have reproducible steps and root cause)
